item.title: Appeals Court Upholds Florida’s Ban On Lab-Grown Meat
item.description: TALLAHASSEE – Florida’s ban on cultivated meat will remain in effect after a federal appeals court upheld the law in a ruling released Monday. Upside Foods, a California-based company that grows and sells cultivated chicken, brought the suit after the law (SB 1084) prohibiting the manufacture, sale and distribution of lab-grown meat took effect [...]

item.description: Governor Ron DeSantis was in Sebring Monday, where he signed into law this year's farm bill, touting it as a move that will deliver much needed relief for farmers across the state.
